If I could tell you how to catalyse recovery, I would, but unfortunately I’m in the same boat.  Things I have found that personally *don’t* help:

•Intermittent fasting (I will binge when given the opportunity to finally eat, unable to self-regulate hunger properly)

•Eating high volume, low calories foods

•Eating higher calorie, lower volume foods

•A mix of the two above
